# ChillShell - Mobile SSH Terminal

> ChillShell is a mobile SSH terminal application for Android and iOS that lets developers securely connect to remote servers from their phone.

## Key Features
- Full SSH terminal with Ed25519 key support
- CLI agent integration (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, Codex)
- Wake-on-LAN remote PC startup
- Tailscale VPN integration for remote access anywhere
- Multi-session terminal management
- Dark and light theme support
- 12 color themes, 5 languages

## Security
- SSH keys stored in device secure enclave (AES-CBC on Android, Keychain on iOS)
- PIN protected with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (100,000 iterations)
- TOFU (Trust On First Use) host verification
- No data collection — all data stays on device
- Root/jailbreak detection at launch
- Auto-lock after inactivity
- White-box security audit: 8.5/10
- STRIDE threat model: 100% mitigated

## Pricing
- 7-day free trial with full features
- One-time purchase: $2.99 / 2.99 EUR
- Lifetime access, no subscription
